events.title: Cadillac repeats the leachate revenue caution in FY2019 budget planning
events.finding: The April2 work-session FY2019 budget material again reports above-budget leachate revenue, cautions against excessive reliance and identifies additional revenue for system reinvestment (PDF p4).
events.significance: Corroborates the recurring City revenue-and-reinvestment policy, not an individual load, receipt or signed leachate rate. It does not establish that every planned activity occurred.

sources.name: ADID_1041_April_2_2018_Work_Session_Minutes.pdf
sources.result: April 2, 2018 work-session minutes and FY2019 budget material. PDF p4 reports leachate revenue continuing above budget, cautions against excessive reliance and identifies additional revenue for system reinvestment. The proposed 3% general water/sewer increase on p3 is not a signed leachate treatment rate. Budget discussion is not a per-load receiving record, customer invoice or proof of a completed delivery.
